data.what_it_does: Provides a Matrix Dart SDK for integrating Matrix chat, E2EE, and VoIP functionality into Dart and Flutter applications. It handles things like session management, timeline decryption, and synchronization.
use_when: You are building a Matrix chat client in Dart or Flutter
You need Matrix protocol support with end-to-end encryption
avoid_when: You are not using the Matrix protocol for your application
You need a simple HTTP client without chat protocol overhead
strengths: Full Matrix SDK written natively in Dart
weaknesses: Requires native library setup for E2EE (vodozemac)
Niche application domain limited to Matrix
data.setup_notes: For E2EE, vodozemac must be provided (e.g. using the flutter_vodozemac package).
data.minimal_example:
flutter pub add matrix

# Optional: For end to end encryption:
flutter pub add flutter_vodozemac
